description: Defines the VideoRendererImpl class, a component responsible for reading from a VideoDecoderStream, managing decoded video frames, and rendering them via a sink. It includes methods for initialization, flushing, starting playback, handling time progression, and rendering frames, along with internal state management and callback handling.

classes.name: VideoRendererImpl
classes.description: Implements video rendering by managing a decoder stream, buffering frames, and rendering via a sink. Handles initialization, state transitions, frame management, and callbacks for decoding and rendering.

methods.name: VideoRendererImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with task runner, sink, decoder creation callback, and other parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a demuxer stream, CDM context, client, time callback, and init callback.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the renderer, clearing buffers and resetting state.

methods.name: StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from a specified timestamp.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders a video frame within specified deadlines and rendering mode.

methods.name: OnFrameDropped
methods.description: Handles logic when a frame is dropped.

methods.name: GetPreferredRenderInterval
methods.description: Returns the preferred interval between renders.
